title: Why it sucks being a Liverpool fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Liverpool fan!
It starts when you're seven. Top of the league. Three games left. Your captain... slips. Your dad still doesn't talk about it.
Age eleven. Champions League final. Your keeper throws the ball out... straight to their striker. Your dad doesn't talk about that either.
Age twelve. Ninety-seven points. Amazing! Second place.
Age thirteen. You finally win the league! After thirty years! Fans aren't allowed in the stadium. You celebrate... on your sofa.
Age fifteen. You're chasing four trophies. You win two. Your dad calls it... a disappointing season.
Age seventeen. Klopp leaves. You cry for a week. Next season, you win the league anyway! Now you feel guilty.
That's the thing about being a Liverpool fan. Even the good days hurt a little.
But you'll never walk alone. Even when you really want to.
Tag a Liverpool fan who still talks about Istanbul. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
